inputs.empty_message: {filename} holds no Hotel or Flights rows. A portal export for another category cannot be reconciled as travel.

fields.formula: IFS(billing_type = "Invoice", "Invoice", billing_type = "Credit for Returns", "Credit for Returns", CONTAINS(billing_type, "credit"), "Credit for Returns", TRUE, "unknown")

columns.value: IF(verdict <> "matched", LABEL("unmatched_reason", verdict), IFS(AND(ABS(base_diff) > param.base_tolerance, ABS(vendor_commission - vendor_expected_commission) > param.commission_tolerance), "Base & commission differ", ABS(base_diff) > param.base_tolerance, "Base differs", ABS(vendor_commission - vendor_expected_commission) > param.commission_tolerance, "Commission differs", TRUE, "Matched"))

cells.text: Net Payable at the contract rate

fields.formula: IF(n_lines = 0, IF(ISBLANK(portal), "international", portal.locality), IF(n_localities = 1, FIRSTX("lines", line_locality), IF(ABS(local_base) >= ABS(intl_base), "local", "international")))
IFS(NOT(has_credit), "none", v_cancel + v_change > param.base_tolerance, "partial", AND(has_invoice, v_base > param.base_tolerance), "partial", TRUE, "full")

stops.message: "The portal export carried no dated travel rows"
stops.about: The portal export has no dated travel bookings.

row_rules.detail: QUOTE(sheet) & " row " & row & ": invoiced row carries no booking id" & " (" & invoice_no & ")"
row_rules.about: An invoiced claim row with no booking ID.

row_rules.detail: COALESCE(payment_method, "no method") & ": wallet " & MONEY(wallet_amount) & " + card " & MONEY(card_amount) & " does not make the order total " & MONEY(order_total)
row_rules.about: A portal booking whose wallet and card amounts don't add up to its total.

row_rules.detail: "paid for (" & payment_status & ") but " & status & ", and commission was still taken"
row_rules.about: An expired or pending booking that was paid, with commission still taken.
A claim adjustment with no booking ID to link it to.
A claim adjustment applied to a booking.

rules.note: refund & " refund credited on the claim" & IF(vendor_cancel_fee + vendor_change_fee <> 0, "; " & (vendor_cancel_fee + vendor_change_fee) & " in fees retained", "") & IF(vendor_commission <> 0, "; vendor commission " & vendor_commission & " still billed", "") & IF(portal_rows > 0, "; the portal shows " & COALESCE(portal_status, "unknown"), "; no portal row" & IF(ISBLANK(booking_date), "; booking date unknown", "; booked " & booking_date & IFS(booking_date < export_start, ", before " & "the portal export (" & export_start & " to " & export_end & ")" & "", booking_date > export_end, ", after " & "the portal export (" & export_start & " to " & export_end & ")" & "", TRUE, ", inside " & "the portal export (" & export_start & " to " & export_end & ")")))
rules.about: Refunded on the claim, in full or in part.

rules.note: IF(match_state = "matched", "cancelled on the portal, but the claim bills it with no credit note", "cancelled on the portal; not on the claim")
COALESCE(portal_status, "unknown") & " on the portal; not on the claim"
rules.about: Only on the portal, and not processed there.
Only on the portal, and there is no claim to compare with.

rules.note: "not billed on the claim" & IF(ISBLANK(booking_date), "; booking date unknown", "; booked " & booking_date & IFS(booking_date < claim_start, ", before " & "this claim's week (" & claim_start & " to " & claim_end & ")" & ", so expected on another claim", booking_date > claim_end, ", after " & "this claim's week (" & claim_start & " to " & claim_end & ")" & ", so expected on another claim", TRUE, ", inside " & "this claim's week (" & claim_start & " to " & claim_end & ")"))
rules.about: Only on the portal: not billed on the claim.

rules.note: IF(n_lines > 0, "billed on the claim", "adjusted by " & vendor_adjustment & " on the claim") & ", no portal row" & IF(ISBLANK(booking_date), "; booking date unknown", "; booked " & booking_date & IFS(booking_date < export_start, ", before " & "the portal export (" & export_start & " to " & export_end & ")" & "", booking_date > export_end, ", after " & "the portal export (" & export_start & " to " & export_end & ")" & "", TRUE, ", inside " & "the portal export (" & export_start & " to " & export_end & ")"))
rules.about: Only on the claim: no portal booking.

rules.note: "billed on the claim while the portal shows " & COALESCE(portal_status, "unknown")
rules.about: Billed on the claim while the portal shows a status other than Processed.

findings.detail: COALESCE(portal_status, "booked") & " on the portal, not billed on this claim (booked " & booking_date & ", outside its week)"
findings.about: On the portal but not on this claim, booked before the claim's week.

findings.detail: COALESCE(portal_status, "booked") & " on the portal, not billed on this claim (booked " & booking_date & ", outside its week)"
findings.about: On the portal but not on this claim, booked after the claim's week.

findings.detail: COALESCE(portal_status, "booked") & " on the portal, not billed on this claim"
findings.when: AND(match_state = "portal_only", NOT(AND(has_claim, OR(booking_date < claim_start, booking_date > claim_end))))
findings.about: On the portal but not billed on the claim.

findings.detail: "billed on the claim, no portal row (booked " & COALESCE(booking_date, "unknown") & ")"
findings.about: Billed on the claim with no portal booking, booked before the portal export's dates.

findings.detail: "billed on the claim, no portal row (booked " & COALESCE(booking_date, "unknown") & ")"
findings.about: Billed on the claim with no portal booking, booked after the portal export's dates.

findings.detail: "billed on the claim, no portal row (booked " & COALESCE(booking_date, "unknown") & ")"
findings.about: Billed on the claim but missing from the portal.

findings.detail: "we booked " & portal_base & ", they billed " & vendor_base
findings.about: Matched, but our base amount and the vendor's differ by more than the tolerance.

findings.detail: "refunded with " & MONEY(v_cancel) & " cancellation fee and " & MONEY(v_change) & " change fee retained"
findings.about: A partial refund: the vendor kept a cancellation or change fee.

findings.detail: "credited on the claim while the portal still says Processed"
findings.about: Credited on the claim while the portal still shows the booking as Processed.

findings.detail: "the credit note leaves the vendor's commission standing"
findings.about: Refunded, but the credit note leaves the vendor's commission standing.

findings.detail: "the portal still retains its commission on a refunded booking"
findings.about: Refunded, but the portal still keeps its commission.

findings.detail: "cancelled on the portal with no credit note on the claim"
findings.when: AND(refund = "none", portal_status = "Cancelled", OR(NOT(has_claim), AND(NOT(ISBLANK(booking_date)), booking_date >= claim_start, booking_date <= claim_end)))
findings.about: Cancelled on the portal with no credit note on the claim.

findings.detail: "billed " & vendor_commission & " where " & vendor_expected_commission & " is contractual (" & COALESCE(PERCENT(vendor_rate, 4), "—") & " against " & COALESCE(PERCENT(contract_rate, 4), "—") & ")"
findings.about: The vendor billed more commission than the contract allows.

findings.detail: "billed " & vendor_commission & " where " & vendor_expected_commission & " is contractual"
findings.about: The vendor billed less commission than the contract allows.

findings.detail: "we charged " & portal_commission & " where our own " & COALESCE(PERCENT(base_rate, 4), "—") & " rate makes " & sg_expected_commission
findings.about: Our commission doesn't match our own rate.

findings.detail: n_lines & " invoice lines compared as one booking"
findings.about: A booking with several invoice lines, compared as one.

findings.detail: "portal row " & row & " of " & QUOTE(sheet) & " repeats this booking; excluded from the totals"
findings.about: The same booking appears again in the portal export; the extra row is left out of the totals.

findings.detail: "the booking id, the portal and the claim disagree: flight, hotel"
findings.when: AND(OR(COUNTX("lines", line_vertical = "hotel") > 0, portal.vertical = "hotel", id_vertical = "hotel"), OR(COUNTX("lines", line_vertical = "flight") > 0, portal.vertical = "flight", id_vertical = "flight"))
findings.about: The booking ID, the portal and the claim disagree: hotel or flight.

findings.detail: "the claim's own lines disagree about whether VAT applies"
findings.about: The claim's own lines disagree about whether VAT applies.

findings.detail: "the portal reads " & portal.locality & " and the claim " & locality
findings.about: The portal and the claim disagree about whether VAT applies.

run_rules.detail: COUNTX("short") & " international booking(s) were charged our local rate while the vendor bills that rate plus VAT; the difference is commission we never collected from the customer"
run_rules.about: International bookings were charged our local rate while the vendor bills that rate plus VAT.
